infotexts.entitydescription.mcfe_captainahapsuit: A worn captain's uniform. His prosthetic leg reveals that he once lost a limb, though he never lost the desire to return for the one who took it from him.
infotexts.missiondescription.Hunt_PaleTom: Captain Ahab provided me with the data and exact location of the infamous Crawler known as Pale Tom, whose elimination will earn a substantial reward. He strictly warned me not to take it lightly, so I'd better prepare heavy weaponry and recruit a good crew before going after it.
infotexts.missionmessage0.Hunt_PaleTom: The Crawler known as Pale Tom has been annihilated. Impeccable work. Leave the area immediately to collect your reward.
infotexts.missiondescription.Hunt_Black_Morgan: Captain Ahab warns us that we are close to the lair of a dangerous Mudraptor known as Black Morgan. The few witnesses who have survived an encounter describe a beast of enormous size. We'd better proceed with caution.
infotexts.missionmessage0.Hunt_Black_Morgan: The Mudraptor has fallen. Excellent work. You'd better get out of there immediately to collect your reward.
infotexts.missiondescription.Hunt_Golden_Reed: A dangerous Spineling named Golden Reed has been spotted prowling and hunting in this sector. According to Captain Ahab's reports, its lethality and aggression should not be taken lightly.
infotexts.missionmessage0.Hunt_Golden_Reed: You've managed to get rid of the beast; undoubtedly, a feat worthy of being told to future generations. You'd better leave this cave immediately to collect your reward.
infotexts.missiondescription.Hunt_Dust_Rowan: A powerful Bone Thresher named Dust Rowan is lurking in this area. If common specimens are already deadly enough, it is difficult to imagine an even more aggressive and dangerous beast.
infotexts.missionmessage0.Hunt_Dust_Rowan: The fearsome Dust Rowan has been slain; undoubtedly, a brutal battle that demonstrates what a true hunter is capable of. We'd better get out of here immediately to collect the reward.
infotexts.missiondescription.Hunt_Night_Ellis: The Mantis known as Night Ellis inhabits these waters. According to Ahab's warnings, survivors claim it has additional stingers; a single sting would be enough to induce paralysis. We'd better proceed with extreme caution.
infotexts.missionmessage0.Hunt_Night_Ellis: The deadly hunter has been slain. There is still a slight numbness in our limbs from the venom, but nothing we cannot handle. Let's get out of here immediately and collect the reward.
infotexts.missiondescription.Hunt_Swift_Elliot: Captain Ahab warned me about the presence of a pink Hammerhead named Swift Elliot, so named because of its unusual speed. Fortunately, this mission takes place aboard the submarine, so with the entire crew on board, we'll be able to overcome the challenge. The report indicates that due to its mutation, it is undetectable by sonar; gunners, keep your eyes open.
infotexts.missionmessage0.Hunt_Swift_Elliot: It was as fast as they said; every charge made the metal bulkheads tremble. Thank goodness it is no longer among us. We'd better leave this horrifying place immediately and collect the reward.
infotexts.missiondescription.Hunt_Iron_Mercer: I still find it hard to believe what the reports say: this Black Moloch called Iron Mercer emits so much heat that pieces of several submarines have literally melted onto its shell. Without a doubt, a fascinating enemy. As Ahab warned, its intense thermal field can be felt from several meters away and is capable of wreaking havoc.
infotexts.missionmessage0.Hunt_Iron_Mercer: Someone get me an ice-cold beer! I suppose this must be what summer feels like, according to the history books of Earth. Anyway, the colossal mollusk has been annihilated; exquisite work. Let's get out of here immediately and collect the reward.
infotexts.missionname.Hunt_Lisa: Hunt for Lisa, the Eternal Mother
infotexts.missiondescription.Hunt_Lisa: Captain Ahab was visibly concerned when assigning me this mission; without a doubt, this specimen is the most unnatural of them all. It is a Crawler Broodmother, another of its kind, but it has been genetically altered by Coalition scientists, and this monstrosity must be eradicated at all costs. Sightings indicate that it frantically vomits Crawler offspring from its mouth, which is why they call her "Lisa, the Eternal Mother".
infotexts.missionmessage0.Hunt_Lisa: It is never a good idea to tamper with the genetics of local wildlife without proper safety protocols; luck has been on our side this time. Let's get out of here immediately and collect the reward; I doubt I'll be able to sleep after this.
infotexts.missiondescription.Hunt_Grim_Lazarus: Captain Ahab decided to join us on this journey; it seems this is the cursed beast that tore off his leg. Grim Lazarus, as he calls it: a gigantic and completely albino Latcher. I have never been enthusiastic about descending into the abyss, but the pay is enormous, and ridding the world of such a monster is a true service to humanity.
infotexts.missionmessage0.Hunt_Grim_Lazarus: The great devourer has been annihilated, and the captain has finally had his revenge. Without a doubt, one of the greatest epics I have ever lived through. Let's leave this abyss immediately and collect our well-deserved reward.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab.c0: You observe an old man wearing a black captain's uniform, a medal on his chest, and a modern prosthetic in place of one leg. \n\n Don't stare at it too much, lad. A sailor's life leaves marks that are difficult to erase. If you're not careful, you could lose more than just your way.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab.o0: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to disrespect you by staring.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab.o1.c1: Don't worry about it. You seem to have some guts. Are you interested in real challenges?
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab.o1.o1.c1: As you can see, I'm old and retired, but I still lead an organization: the "Hunter's Call". Our purpose is to eradicate the marine threats that put humanity in jeopardy. We don't hunt just any creature, but those that have spread so much terror that sailors themselves have given them names.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab.o1.o1.o1: Sounds interesting. Is the pay worth it?
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab.o1.o1.o1.c1: It is. Though, to be honest, I haven't had to pay anyone yet; none of those I sent ever came back to collect. If you accept, your first target will be Pale Tom: an old Crawler, paler and more cunning than the rest of its kind.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab.o1.o1.o1.o1: How much damage can a simple Crawler do? The ones you sent before must have been rookies.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab.o1.o1.o1.o1.c1: They died because they underestimated it, exactly as you're doing now. That specimen learned how to hunt us: it doesn't fall for sonar traps and prefers to stalk from the shadows. Many of the beasts on my list do the same: they wait in their lairs until their prey lets its guard down.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab.o1.o1.o1.o1.o1: I still don't see why you're so afraid of a simple creature.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab.o1.o1.o1.o1.o1.c1: Beasts learn and adapt too, lad. Here, take these coordinates to its territory. If you manage to kill it and return to tell the tale, we'll speak again.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab2.c0: You survived and eliminated Pale Tom; it seems we finally have a hunter worth his salt. How did you find the challenge?
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab2.o0: Nothing I couldn't handle. In fact, it turned out to be easier than I expected.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab2.o1: Truth is, I underestimated it. It nearly tore my arm off, and I learned why it was considered a threat; I survived thanks to my strategy.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab2.o2: I heeded your warnings and came well prepared. Good thing I did, because this could have ended very badly.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab2.o0.c1: Easy, eh? Don't worry, the next target will take care of that confidence.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab2.o1.c1: Underestimating these predators is foolish. Good thing you had a plan to tip the scales in your favor; we learn from our mistakes. I hope you'll be better prepared mentally for the next challenge.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab2.o2.c1: Congratulations! A smart hunter. Listening to my warnings and preparing your equipment accordingly was the best decision you could have made; otherwise, you'd have already lost a limb. Knowing you're a cautious one, I think you'll enjoy the next target.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab2.o0.o1.c1: Mudraptors are magnificent predators, some of the ones that have given us the most trouble, but also the ones that taught us how to adapt to this moon. I even had one as a pet myself, named "Frederick," though not all of them are so docile; this one, in particular, is terrifying. Known as Black Morgan because of the dark tone of its plates, this specimen far surpasses its kin in size and strength. Remember that its natural armor is dense; make sure you use armor-piercing weaponry. Good luck, hunter, and heed the call!
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab3.c0: When I signed off on your payment for Black Morgan's head, I couldn't help but be impressed; it seems you're truly effective. Were you hunting fauna in the depths of Europa before this?
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab3.o0: Hunting? Quite the opposite. I spent my time surviving their attempts to devour my crew; those close calls are how I learned to be cautious.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab3.o1: I always took part in extermination missions in caves and nests. That experience taught me how they operate... and the pay wasn't bad either.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab3.o2: To be honest, this is the first time I've accepted contracts of this caliber. I suppose preparation and a little luck have kept me alive.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab3.o0.c1: Ah... back when I still captained my own vessel, the "Rosa del Callao," I had several fights to the death with spinelings. Who would've thought their ability to fire spines could pierce the reinforced steel of a submarine? And speaking of spinelings...
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab3.o1.c1: So cave diving is your specialty. Nothing a few good harpoons can't solve. In fact, in my younger days I used to make and sell them myself, before my workshop finally closed down. But speaking of piercing ammunition...
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab3.o2.c1: There is no such thing as luck in this abyss; your caution and sound judgment are what keep you breathing. If you keep that attitude, you'll go far as a captain. You're going to love this next target.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab3.o0.o1: Let me guess... the next target is a spineling?
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab3.o1.o1: Those legendary harpoons were yours? I've heard they're worth a fortune, and not just because of the damage they inflict.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab3.o2.o1: Thanks for the advice, Captain. What's the next contract about?
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab3.o0.o1.c1: That's right, we have a winner! But it's no ordinary spineling. Golden Reed stands out because of the unmistakable golden pigment on its plates. Don't let its striking color fool you: precisely because of that anomaly, it travels alone, since such a conspicuous color ruins the ambushes of any school. However, that weakness sharpened its instincts, turning it into a fierce and relentless hunter. The few survivors who have faced it ended up covered in spines, but it's a minor challenge for someone with your experience. Good luck, hunter, and heed the call!
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab3.o1.o1.c1: Exactly, those harpoons came from my own hands. If you find one during your travels, don't hesitate to use it: its reliability is absolute. And as I was saying, speaking of piercing ammunition, your next target is a very peculiar spineling. Golden Reed possesses a golden pigment that makes it unmistakable. Don't let its striking color fool you: it travels alone because such a bright color ruins the ambushes of a conventional school. Far from being a disadvantage, it forced it to become a solitary, aggressive, and lethal predator. Those who managed to escape it described being caught in a rain of spines, but I know you can handle this. Good luck, hunter, and heed the call!
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab3.o2.o1.c1: Your next target is a spineling, but not an ordinary one. Golden Reed is a specimen with a striking golden pigment. Don't let its color fool you: it travels alone because such a bright color ruins any attempt at a group ambush. However, that same condition forced it to become an exceptionally aggressive and dangerous hunter. The survivors of its attacks ended up covered in spines, but nothing someone with your judgment and preparation can't handle; you've already proven that in the field. Good luck, hunter, and heed the call!
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab4.c0: Well, well, are you the best hunter in my company? I could see that you took down Golden Reed without much trouble. I hope it didn't leave any deep scars on you or your crew.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab4.o0: Just a few battle scars. Truth be told, it was quite a frantic fight; that thing was incredibly fast.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab4.o1: I have a good hole in my leg thanks to one of its spines. You weren't lying when you said it was wild.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab4.o2: If its old shoal had accepted it instead of isolating it, perhaps they would have had more success. It really was a fierce predator.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab4.o0.c1: At least the miners who suffered its attacks will be grateful to you; those wounds always end up telling stories, you'll see. Now, the next target is one of the worst; in fact, no one has survived to tell the tale. The little we know is thanks to recordings from reconnaissance drones.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab4.o1.c1: Better to have a hole in your leg than lose it entirely, don't you think? But speaking of losses, the next target doesn't know that word; there are no surviving witnesses, only a few recordings captured by drones.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab4.o2.c1: Its own kind banished it for being different, never imagining that this would turn it into a perfect killing machine. As the saying goes: "You don't know what you have until you lose it." And speaking of losses, we've lost many miners because of the next target; its kill record is absolute, so there are no survivors, and all we have are drone records.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab4.o0.o1: Not a single survivor? Captain, exactly where are you sending me?
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab4.o0.o1.c1: Easy, hunter. Its name is Dust Rowan, a formidable Bone Thresher whose lair is very close to our current position. When you enter there, take every precaution possible: ordinary specimens are already lethal, but this individual operates on another level. It hunts alone to maximize the element of surprise, which explains how it has survived in the ocean for so long. Fortunately, the drones managed to tag it with a tracker just like the others. Its coloration is more like sand with a few small black spots; that's where the nickname comes from as well. Good luck, hunter, and heed the call!
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab5.c0: Hunter, at this rate you're going to bankrupt me with all this efficiency. I suppose this terrifying experience has given you an entirely new perspective on underwater combat.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab5.o0: The only thing it left me with is empty positions in my crew... What a horrible creature.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab5.o1: Quite the suicide mission inside those caves. The abyss doesn't feel the same after this.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab5.o2: Easy as pie! Nothing you can't overcome with a cool head.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab5.o0.c1: I regret the casualties; life in these seas is merciless. Still, this harsh lesson will help you sharpen your tactics and minimize losses in the future. Your next target is the last one that maintains a terrestrial lair; this will be the last time you venture into the caves to hunt.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab5.o1.c1: They say fear is a survival mechanism, but it can also be an anchor. Don't let it steer your helm, especially now that the toughest challenges are approaching. This will be your final cave mission.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab5.o2.c1: I can sense that arrogance you had on the first day returning. Surviving Dust Rowan is something to be proud of, but don't let confidence blind your decisions. Anyway, your next assignment will be the last one inside the caves.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab5.o0.o1: The last one in the caves? What kind of creature are we dealing with this time?
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab5.o0.o1.c1: We're talking about one of the most elusive specimens in Europa. They are rarely seen, and that's because of their impressive camouflage abilities. Mantises are already a nightmare for the unwary, but this one is the deadliest ever documented. Night Ellis has three main stingers instead of one. An evolutionary mutation that benefits it? Without a doubt: by injecting triple the dose of toxin, the paralysis shuts down the nervous system within seconds. Take extreme precautions with this one, hunter. Good luck, and heed the call!
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab6.c0: Hunter, you have accomplished what no one else could: securing the depths of the caves. Although the wildlife still inhabits them, their greatest predators are now dead. So forget about organizing excursions on foot or calibrating defense robots to explore the surface.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab6.o0: Excursions, you say? That Mantis's sting left my crew crippled for days.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab6.o1: What a shame. In a way, I had already grown fond of the caves' claustrophobia.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab6.o2: Nothing beats the solid protection of submarine-grade steel.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab6.o0.c1: Ha, ha! Occupational hazards of being a sailor. Anyway, your next target is a "golden" Hammerhead... or rather, pink. They call it Swift Elliot: it has developed additional fins that grant it tremendous speed. Its body also emits a harmonic vibration that amplifies the force of its charges and makes it completely invisible to sonar, making it impossible to tag with a tracker. But don't worry, hunter: chances are it will find you first. Keep the gunners on maximum alert. Good luck, and heed the call!
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab6.o1.c1: It's always good to step outside your comfort zone and stretch your legs... or your keels. Anyway, your next target is a "golden" Hammerhead... or rather, pink. They call it Swift Elliot: it has developed additional fins that grant it tremendous speed. Its body also emits a harmonic vibration that amplifies the force of its charges and makes it completely invisible to sonar, making it impossible to tag with a tracker. But don't worry, hunter: chances are it will find you first. Keep the gunners on maximum alert. Good luck, and heed the call!
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab6.o2.c1: Exactly, nothing beats having a solid steel bulkhead covering your back. Anyway, your next target is a "golden" Hammerhead... or rather, pink. They call it Swift Elliot: it has developed additional fins that grant it tremendous speed. Its body also emits a harmonic vibration that amplifies the force of its charges and makes it completely invisible to sonar, making it impossible to tag with a tracker. But don't worry, hunter: chances are it will find you first. Keep the gunners on maximum alert. Good luck, and heed the call!
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab7.c0: Amazing! Swift Elliot is no longer swimming among us. That troublesome Hammerhead caused far too many problems in this sector; without a doubt, being undetectable by sonar was its greatest advantage.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab7.o0: I have a splitting headache from those repeated impacts against the hull.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab7.o1: I never imagined I'd be hunting this creature in a lair; thankfully, that wasn't necessary.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab7.o2: Lately you've been sending me to hunt creatures with mutations that are far too beneficial. Tell me, is this going to become a pattern?
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab7.o0.c1: A good dose of morphine should take care of your migraines, lad. Though you're going to need much more than that for the next target.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab7.o1.c1: A cave would only have limited its natural agility; for an open-water predator, the best place to hunt it was in its own element. Now, about your next target...
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab7.o2.c1: Quite observant of you. You're absolutely right: the following targets share a genetic trait that gives them a lethal advantage over their kin. In fact, the next one is going to surprise you.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab7.o0.o1: What is it going to be about?
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab7.o0.o1.c1: It's a Black Moloch. If you haven't fought one before, let me warn you: these colossal creatures emit electrical fields capable of frying the submarine's systems. However, this particular specimen, known as Iron Mercer, has an even worse peculiarity. Unlike its brethren, it radiates such extreme heat that getting too close will cause severe burns. You'll recognize it easily because it has destroyed so many submarines that parts of their metal hulls have literally fused onto its shell; that's where its name comes from. Keep your engineers on maximum alert to repair constant damage throughout the battle. Good luck, hunter, and heed the call!
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab8.c0: Hunter, in light of all your successes, some Coalition scientists have formally requested our services. Apparently, years ago they secretly experimented on a crawler to accelerate its egg-laying and the growth of its offspring, all with the stupid idea of ensuring food reserves. By the way... how did the hunt against Iron Mercer go?
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab8.o0: A few first-degree burns, nothing too serious. Tell me more about this Coalition business.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab8.o1: Seeing a Moloch covered in chunks of molten metal was an experience no one is going to believe.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab8.o2: I can still feel the heat in my body. I need a good ice-cold drink right now.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab8.o0.c1: The burns will heal on their own with a little ointment, lad. Back to the Coalition: the specimen is called Lisa. The problem is that she has already reached maturity and, unlike common crawlers, gives birth to offspring directly through her mouth. Her brood grows so quickly that they are capable of laying their own eggs almost immediately. To sustain such a metabolic rate, she devours everything in her path, becoming an uncontrollable threat that we must eradicate. Good luck, hunter, and heed the call!
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab8.o1.c1: A fine story to brag about in the taverns; at this rate, your legend will surely spread across all of Europa. Back to the Coalition: the specimen is called Lisa. The problem is that she has already reached maturity and, unlike common crawlers, gives birth to offspring directly through her mouth. Her brood grows so quickly that they are capable of laying their own eggs almost immediately. To sustain such a metabolic rate, she devours everything in her path, becoming an uncontrollable threat that we must eradicate. Good luck, hunter, and heed the call!
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab8.o2.c1: Nothing better than a good beer or some handcrafted rum to soothe the throat; you should stop by the bars at the outposts from time to time. Back to the Coalition: the specimen is called Lisa. The problem is that she has already reached maturity and, unlike common crawlers, gives birth to offspring directly through her mouth. Her brood grows so quickly that they are capable of laying their own eggs almost immediately. To sustain such a metabolic rate, she devours everything in her path, becoming an uncontrollable threat that we must eradicate. Good luck, hunter, and heed the call!
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab9.c0: You did it, hunter! You have exterminated almost every threat on this moon. But now comes the grand finale: the most fearsome beast of them all.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab9.o0: More fearsome than Lisa? That fight was a nightmare; swarms of offspring invaded the submarine, and I almost lost half my crew.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab9.o1: You should pay me life insurance upfront. The last mission was hell.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab9.o2: I managed to keep the situation under control during the last mission. What the hell could be worse than Lisa?
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab9.o0.c1: Easy, hunter. This creature is Grim Lazarus, my personal nemesis... the damned beast responsible for taking my leg.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab9.o1.c1: You don't need insurance; you aren't going to die here, otherwise you wouldn't have made it this far. Back to the matter at hand: this creature is Grim Lazarus, my personal nemesis, the one responsible for taking my leg.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab9.o2.c1: With that carefree attitude, you'll handle this and more. Back to the matter at hand: this creature is Grim Lazarus, my personal nemesis, the one responsible for taking my leg.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab9.o0.o1: Was that the monster that tore off your leg?
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab9.o0.o1.c1: Yes, that abominable latcher did it. It's a colossal specimen, with completely albino skin and a gaze that reeks of death. The countless scars across its body are proof of the battles it has fought, and unlike its kin, it can fire twice as many rows of teeth. It's a true killing machine. This time I won't let you go alone: I'll board the submarine with you. Together, we'll heed the hunter's call until the very end.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab10.c0: At last, it's dead... With this, the souls of my crew can finally rest in peace. You did it, hunter; I owe you my life and my vengeance. Without a doubt, when all is said and done, the true alpha of these depths is you. From now on, you will lead the «Hunter's Call». At last, I can hang up my harpoons and retire in peace.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab10.o0: It was an honor to fight alongside you, sir.
infotexts.eventtext.Ahab10.c1: The honor was all mine, hunter.
